en.headline: Weekend outlook: cloudy with showers and isolated thunderstorms
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects mainly cloudy skies with a few showers this weekend, more frequent at first on Saturday and later on Sunday, under a broad trough of low pressure.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory’s latest nine-day forecast, issued at 11:30 a.m. on Friday, indicates that a broad trough of low pressure will continue to affect the coast of southern China and nearby seas over the coming days, keeping the weather unsettled.

On Saturday, south to southwest winds of force 4 are expected. It will be mainly cloudy with a few showers, more showers with thunderstorms at first, and bright periods in the afternoon. Temperatures are forecast between 27 and 32 degrees Celsius, with relative humidity of 70 to 95 per cent.

Sunday is expected to remain mainly cloudy with a few showers, becoming more frequent in some areas later with thunderstorms. Temperatures will range from 27 to 31 degrees. The Observatory notes that a tropical cyclone over Beibu Wan is expected to linger and may turn east to northeast early next week, potentially bringing windier conditions and heavier showers to coastal areas from Monday onwards.

zh.headline: 周末展望：多雲有驟雨及局部雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台預料周末大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，周六初時及周日稍後部分地區驟雨較多並有雷暴，受廣闊低壓槽影響。
body: 香港天文台於周五上午11時30分發出的最新九天天氣預報指出，一道廣闊低壓槽會在未來數日持續影響華南沿岸至台灣以東海域一帶，該區天氣不穩定。
周六吹南至西南風4級，大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，初時驟雨較多及有雷暴，下午部分時間天色明朗，氣溫27至32度，相對濕度百分之70至95。
周日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，稍後部分地區驟雨較多及有雷暴，氣溫27至31度。天文台指位於北部灣的熱帶氣旋預料明日於該區徘徊，有較大機會在下周一逐漸轉向東至東北移動，靠近雷州半島至廣東西部沿岸，下周初至中期沿岸地區間中有大驟雨及狂風雷暴，風勢較大。
